Priority: urgent

Fix the root cause of a repeated failure: The planner designs tests and coverage from the intended change and a list of the request's causes,

The same cause has produced failures in more than one job. Find the cause where it originates and fix it there, so the whole class is prevented; do not work around one instance.

Failure class: plan-test-and-scope-ignore-code-order-of-operations-fails-planning-rounds (20261028-082122-nzgx)
Cause: The planner designs tests and coverage from the intended change and a list of the request's causes, not from a trace of the run path up to the point under test. It never checks that its fixture reaches the code being fixed, or that each cau...
Seen 2 time(s) in 2 jobs. The introspections that record it:
Introspection 20261028-082109-3qkb (job 20261028-081326-zzxg); prevention it proposed: Add a planning check that runs before the critic. For each criterion, the plan must list the ordered gates and steps its demonstration passes through before the code under test, with file:line, and must show the fixture reaches that code. I...
Introspection 20261101-224205-f5td (job 20261101-222517-3kgp); prevention it proposed: Add a required step to planning for any change to record commit timing or order. The plan must list every record writer on the close and landing path (Score, verification, candidate, intervention, others). For each writer it must state when...

Acceptance:
- The root cause is named in the change description and fixed where it originates, not at one instance
- A test fails without the change and passes with it, for the cause and not only for one job
- fmt, clippy and test pass
